The subject features a prominent, bright red comb with a serrated edge and matching red wattles hanging below the beak. The plumage is primarily white on the face and neck, contrasting sharply with the red fleshy parts. The beak is short, curved, and pale yellow/grey. One dark eye with a golden iris is clearly visible. The background is a soft, out-of-focus grey.
